senses.gloss:
भृश् भृश् (connected with rt. भ्रंश्),
cl. 4. P. भृश्यति, to fall, fall down; cl. 6.
P. भृशति, &c., to be strong or vehement (?).

भृश, अस्, आ, अम् (probably fr. rt. भृश् with a
sense ‘to be strong,’ or perhaps contracted fr. भूरि-
शस्), powerful, mighty, strong, vehement, intense,
much, exceeding, frequent; (अम्), ind. vehemently,
strongly, intensely, in a high degree, much, very,
exceedingly, excessively, violently, powerfully, greatly,
extremely, eminently, in a superior manner, beauti-
fully, better, often, repeatedly, quickly.
—भृश-
कोपन, अस्, आ, अम्, extremely passionate, very
wrathful.
—भृश-ता, f. violence, vehemence, inten-
sity; [cf. भार्श्य.]
—भृश-दारुण, अस्, आ, अम्,
very terrible or cruel.
—भृश-दुःखित, अस्, आ,
अम्, very much afflicted, very unfortunate or unhappy.
—भृश-पीडित, अस्, आ, अम्, very much afflicted.
—भृश-विस्मित, अस्, आ, अम्, excessively astonished
or perplexed.
—भृश-शोक-वर्धन, अस्, ई, अम्,
greatly increasing grief or augmenting sorrow.
—भृश-संहृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, very delighted,
very glad.
—भृश-स्विद्, त्, त्, त्, perspiring violently.
—भृशी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, &c., to become
vehement, to become very powerful or strong.

भृशाय, Nom. A. भृशायते, &c., to become
powerful, to be strong or vehement.

भृष्ट 2. भृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. भ्रज्ज्),
fried, broiled, grilled, roasted, parched, scorched, baked;
(अम्), n. roasted meat.
—भृष्ट-कार, अस्, m. a
preparer of roasted or fried meat.
—भृष्टान्न
(˚ट-अन्˚), अम्, n. rice boiled and then fried.

1. भृष्टि, इस्, f. the act of frying, broiling,
roasting.

भृष्टि 2. भृष्टि, इस्, f. (perhaps fr. rt. हृष्),
Ved. a spike, point, top, corner, edge [cf. सहस्र-
भ्˚, क्षुर-भ्˚, तिग्म-भ्˚, पिशङ्ग-भ्˚]; an
empty or deserted cottage, a deserted garden (=
शून्य-वाटी or शून्य-वाटिका).
—भृष्टि-मत्, आन्,
अती, अत्, pronged, toothed.
